description: Persistence-as-form: hold one minor groove for half the track, drop the floor out for fifteen seconds, restart a semitone lower, and grind louder until the machine is switched off at its peak. One valley, one semitone slip, no comedown, no coda — the opposite answer to ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' dark coda: this one stops at its loudest.
name: user_and_machine

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest passage (mean -27.2dB RMS). Sparsest sound in the track at 0:00 (MFCC1 -337.8); first layer enters ~7s. Centroid climbs 1373 to ~2800Hz as layers enter. Patient, low, dark start.

sections.name: Groove A (Eb minor)
sections.notes: First plateau, Eb natural minor, i-iv-v color. Per-minute tempo 136.0. Steady bright top end (centroid ~3000-3600Hz). Let the groove run unbroken — no cuts, no false drops.

sections.name: Groove A' (Eb minor, louder)
sections.notes: Same Eb-minor material, slightly louder (means -20.9 to -21.2dB), per-minute tempo 143.6 (step unverified by downbeat grid). Local peaks -18.2dB at 3:40, -18.5dB at 3:45 — the climb right before the floor drops out.

sections.name: The valley (hinge)
sections.notes: The track's only break, 15s at 51% runtime. RMS -30.0dB at 4:00 (11.5dB fall in 15s), centroid halved to 1610Hz, MFCC1 -269.2. The root slips Eb->D inside the valley. Deep but not silence — the machine idles, it doesn't stop.

sections.name: Rebuild (D minor)
sections.notes: Restart a semitone lower. Level climbs from -28.1dB back to -21.5dB; centroid recovers to ~3000Hz. The rebuild IS the section — the machine coming back online on a lower gear.

sections.name: Plateau (D minor)
sections.notes: Steady grind in D minor with a blurred third (F and F# at comparable strength — never resolve the color). Two brief pullbacks (6:10-6:15 to -27.9dB; 6:30 to -26.0dB with the track's loudest peak, -6.5dB) that rebound within one window.

sections.name: Final push (end at peak)
sections.notes: Loudest sustained passage (mean -17.9dB for 7:00-7:30, max window -17.2dB at 7:10). Final window loud (-17.6dB) AND spectrally collapsed (centroid 966Hz, rolloff 1843Hz) — a dark stamp at full volume. Hard stop at 7:32.4, no fade, no coda. Reserve the dynamic maximum for the ending.
